mapper.select: SELECT * FROM online_regression_runs ORDER BY COALESCE(finished_at, created_at) DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO online_regression_runs (id, status, selected_apps, selected_features, ordered_steps, enable_overseas_proxy, environment, track, pass_rate, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{status}, #{selectedApps}, #{selectedFeatures}, #{orderedSteps}, #{enableOverseasProxy}, #{environment}, #{track}, #{passRate}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE online_regression_runs SET status = #{status}, selected_apps = #{selectedApps}, selected_features = #{selectedFeatures}, ordered_steps = #{orderedSteps}, enable_overseas_proxy = #{enableOverseasProxy}, environment = #{environment}, track = #{track}, pass_rate = #{passRate}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
